overview.Name: Into the Arcane
overview.Theme: The Arcane animated series: Piltover and Zaun factions (Rebel, Enforcer, Chem-Baron, Black Rose, Academy, Family, Experiment).

mechanics: Anomalies: at round 4-6 a champion is placed in the middle of the board and gains one Anomaly effect for the rest of the game. The Anomaly can be rerolled for 1 gold as often as wanted; after the whole pool is seen it starts over. Once per game, one champion. 61 Anomalies below.

Chem-Baron: gain Shimmer after each player combat (more on a loss streak of 3+). Every 100 Shimmer the Black Market offers contraband only Chem-Barons can use; skipping a market gives Chem-Barons max Health. See trait text.

Riot changed patch naming in 2025: patches during Set 13 in 2025 were labeled 13.3 to 13.6, and from Set 14 onward the TFT patch number matches the set number (14.1, 15.1, ...). The League client version (CDragon path) still uses 15.x and 16.x.
CDragon also contains variants TFTSet13_Evolved and TFTSet13_Evolved_MacaoMode. Their purpose is not documented in the data; they are not covered here.

source.line: CommunityDragon `https://raw.communitydragon.org/15.6/cdragon/tft/en_us.json` (set data `TFTSet13`) for champions, stats, abilities, traits, items and augments. MetaTFT lookup `https://data.metatft.com/lookups/TFTSet13_latest_en_us.json` (retrieved 2026-10-15) for spell calculation formulas used to fill computed tooltip values, augment rarity where CDragon has none, and set-mechanic lists.
